summary:

The new AbsenceInheritance certificate transfers a common base's one accessible absence witness to each actual same-bearer dependent and their joint absence, without recombination. Essential interpretation uses the separately encoded OPEN EssenceAbsenceBridge, not a definition of essence as modality. ReplacementBoundary retains populated worlds, the same necessary target and existing causal sources at both worlds while replacing the actual contingent source; it isolates why actual causation/reason provision alone does not imply essential modal requirement and reuses directedNature's asymmetric essence versus symmetric necessary co-presence. ResourceInheritance checks fixed necessary law/background, actual truthful and truth-preserving prerequisite records, actual reasons for every derivative, existing distinct causes wherever derivatives exist, and no reason for base. It reuses the exact trap theorem to exclude derivability from law/background alone, positively derives every finite layer when base is an admitted primitive, and extracts both base existence and law from ANY derivation admitting no derivative primitive. A necessary-base overlay retains the same actual input and resource obstruction, so explanatory incompleteness is distinct from modal contingency. These are explicit mathematical interpretations, not defended metaphysical possibilities, genuine productive-power certificates, temporal-event dynamics or a proof of universal PSR. Rejected shortcuts: covered as an independent norm; forward determinism as essential necessity; all effects individually brute; necessary labels as explanations; FullSupply as production; hidden recombination; duplicating the trap theorem. Proposed assessment: retain the prior moderate preference for adequate existential explanation E, now sharpened by the retained actual prerequisite, while granting a coherent strongest rival that accepts B and law as primitives and denies an ultimate explanatory demand. Primitive/direct warrant remains legitimate, and no worldview ranking or numerical score follows. C2 compatibility is conceptual only, not a new joint-model certificate. Development compilation and zero-axiom reports pass for all three results; all semantic preflights and offline corpus validation pass. Required integration binding, Comparator, NanoDa and independent final semantic challenge are coordinator-owned. No new registered root-support edge or premise discharge is claimed.
